infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BOP HRMS uses your precise location to verify attendance and field-visit proximity.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BOP HRMS shares your location only while an HRMS attendance record is checked in, including when the app is minimized.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: BOP HRMS shares your location only while an HRMS attendance record is checked in.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to your camera for selfie attendance and document uploads.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow BOP HRMS to use precise location for attendance and field-visit verification.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow BOP HRMS to share location only while your HRMS attendance is checked in.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow RE HRMS to select optional field-visit photo evidence.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow RE HRMS to capture optional field-visit photo evidence.
